subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

________ being an officer, he lives in a very tiny apartment.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Despite."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contrasts the status of being an officer with living in a tiny apartment.
 
• **"Despite" **is used to show that something happens or is true even though there is a potential hindrance or contradiction.
 
• The structure "Despite + noun/noun phrase" fits perfectly here.
 
• It captures the intended meaning of contrasting the expectation associated with being an officer with the reality of the living situation.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) Except is used to indicate an exclusion and does not fit the contrast requirement.
 
• Option 3) Instead signifies a choice between alternatives, which is not the context here.
 
• Option 4) Unlike sets up a comparison between two distinct entities, which is not the intended use in this sentence.
